description.value: The Evening Star Motel is a small independent motel situated on Highway 3, one kilometre east of Greenwood City Centre in BC's Boundary region — one of the smallest cities in Canada. It offers single, kitchen, and family units in a fully renovated facility and is open 365 days a year, making it a reliable stop on the Crowsnest Highway cycling corridor. Nearby attractions include the Trans Canada Trail (which runs parallel to Hwy 3 through Greenwood), heritage walking tours, and Jewel Lake.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides detailed facility information for the Evening Star Motel in Greenwood, BC. Wi-Fi is confirmed both by OSM (internet_access=wlan) and the website ('High-speed Wi-Fi' listed as a booking benefit, 'High Speed Internet' listed in all room descriptions). There is no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying areas, or any cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site. One testimonial references a 'pool' but no pool is described anywhere in the main site content, suggesting this may be a generic template testimonial.
concerns: One customer testimonial references a 'pool' but no pool is described anywhere in the motel's own facility listings — the testimonial may be a generic placeholder from a website template.
No phone number is present in OSM or discoverable on the website; contact information is limited to the web booking form.

Street address (798 North Government Street) is from OSM only — the website describes the location by landmarks (Hwy 3, 1 km east of Greenwood City Centre) without stating the civic address explicitly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating independent motel open 365 days a year on the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3), a popular cycling route. Straightforward inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: The motel explicitly states 'no pets please' and 'all rooms are non-smoking'. Barbeque facility is mentioned on the rooms-and-rates page. Long-distance calls are available free from the office.
